checks.detail: Ike complete-order voyage verifies canonical recognition, immutable approved artifact, project scope, approval gate, and manufacturable lettering size.
Lettering size presets only reduce from the computed safe maximum; Fill equals the largest existing safe fit.
Customer surfaces no longer expose Sea Trial obstacle-avoidance wording.
A new Ike order starts with blank wording; draft restoration remains separate.
Camera permission is requested only after explicit customer action and remains controlled by Safari/iPadOS.
